t.1.177.1: Duryodhana, Durviṣaha, Durmukha, Duṣpradharṣaṇa, Viviṃśati and Vikarṇa, Saha and Duḥśāsana, all together have come.
t.1.177.3: Sukuṇḍala, Citrasena, Suvarcas, Kanakadhvaja, Nandaka, Bāhuśālin, and likewise Kuṇḍaja and Vikaṭa.
t.1.177.2: Yuyutsu and Vātavega, and likewise Bhīmavegadhara, Ugrāyudha and Balākī, Kanakāyu and Virocana.
t.1.177.4: These and many other mighty sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, heroes accompanied by Karṇa, have come here for your sake, high-souled and renowned bulls among kṣatriyas, a hundred in number.
t.1.177.6: Aśvatthāmā and Bhoja, the two best of all bearers of weapons, great-souled ones, have assembled here for your sake, splendidly adorned.
t.1.177.5: Śakuni and Bala, Vṛṣaka and Bṛhadbala: these sons of the king of Gāndhāra have all assembled here.
t.1.177.7: Bṛhanta and Maṇimant, and the valiant Daṇḍadhāra, Sahadeva, Jayatsena, and Meghasaṃdhi the Māgadha.
t.1.177.8: Virāṭa together with his two sons, Śaṅkha and Uttara, Vārdhakṣemi, Suvarcas, and King Senābindu.
t.1.177.10: Sūryadhvaja, Rocamāna, Nīla, and likewise Citrāyudha, Aṃśumant and Cekitāna, and the mighty Śreṇimant.
t.1.177.11: And Samudrasena's son, the valiant Candrasena; Jalasaṃdha; and the father and son Sudaṇḍa and Daṇḍa.
t.1.177.13: Likewise the king of the Madras, Śalya, the great chariot-warrior, came together with his sons, with the heroic Rukmāṅgada and also with Rukmaratha.
t.1.177.12: Pauṇḍraka Vāsudeva and the valiant Bhagadatta, the Kaliṅga and the Tāmralipta, and likewise the lord of Pattana.
t.1.177.14: The Kauravya Somadatta has come, and with him his sons, great chariot-warriors, three heroes assembled together: Bhūri, Bhūriśravas and Śala.
t.1.177.15: Sudakṣiṇa the Kāmboja, and Dṛḍhadhanvā the Kaurava, Bṛhadbala, Suṣeṇa, and likewise Śibi the Auśīnara.
t.1.177.16: Saṃkarṣaṇa, Vāsudeva, and the valiant son of Rukmiṇī, Sāmba and Cārudeṣṇa, Sāraṇa, and Gada as well.
t.1.177.17: Akrūra and Sātyaki, and the mighty Uddhava, Kṛtavarman the son of Hṛdika, and Pṛthu and Vipṛthu as well.
t.1.177.18: Viḍūratha and Kaṅka, Samīka and Sāramejaya, the hero Vātapati, Jhillī and Piṇḍāraka, and the valiant Uśīnara: these Vṛṣṇis have been named to you.
t.1.177.19: Bhagīratha, Bṛhatkṣatra, and Jayadratha the Saindhava, Bṛhadratha, Bāhlika, and the great chariot-warrior Śrutāyu.
t.1.177.9: Abhibhū was there together with his son, with Sudāman and Suvarcas, and so too were Sumitra and Sukumāra, Vṛka, and Satyadhṛti.
t.1.177.21: These and many others, lords of various countries, kṣatriyas renowned on earth, have come here for your sake, O fair lady.
t.1.177.20: King Ulūka Kaitava, Citrāṅgada and Śubhāṅgada, the steadfast king of the Vatsas, and likewise the lord of Kosala.
t.1.177.22: These valiant men will, for your sake, seek to win the supreme target; whoever pierces this target, him you should choose today, O lovely one.
